notes: Board decision eff. 2023-06-01: 20-min/cancel compensation on ALL traffic incl. Oresundstag to/from Denmark; voluntary term above the legal floor, so route distance is irrelevant. Legal floor when other authorities are added: <150km lag 2015:953 (50/75/100% at >20/>40/>60 min); >=150km EU 2021/782 (25% 60-119min, 50% 120+).

Long-distance commercial rail at the EU 2021/782 floor: 25% of fare at 60-119 min, 50% at 120+ min; cancellations claimable. 60-min trigger because SJ applies the regulation floor, not a voluntary term above it (unlike skanetrafiken). Verify against SJ's current resegaranti before enforcing.

Long-distance commercial rail (Snalltaget) at the EU 2021/782 floor: 25% at 60-119 min, 50% at 120+ min; cancellations claimable. 60-min trigger = regulation floor, no voluntary term above it. Verify against Snalltaget's current terms before enforcing.
